component.name: Underfang: Prologue
component.summary: Short psychological horror game - Prologue of Underfang

description.p: Psychological Horror Game. You play as a child who faints while playing with his cousin. You will play his dreams. A great adventure awaits you, with lots of reflections!

You will venture into several dreams that will make you lose your mind! However, you have the ability to sprint to move faster. Watch out, though you have a stamina bar, so manage it wisely throughout your adventure! You will have to escape from or face your worst nightmares... See you on the other side...
